title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 091 ]

blocks.text: The purpose of the court system is to protect the rights of the people. For example, according to American law, if someone is accused of a crime, he is considered innocent until the court proves that the person is guilty. In other words, it is the responsibility of the court to prove that a person is guilty.
